claims.text: In accordance with King Tupou VI's wishes, Cabinet revokes the State mourning proclaimed on 19 March 2012 and fixes a new official period from Monday 19 March to Saturday 31 March 2012 inclusive; made at Nuku'alofa on 30 March 2012.
